scorecards.rationale: Exceptional throughput and determinism make it ideal as a static candidate-generation foundation, but unsuited as a sole dynamic similarity proxy due to false-familiarity blind spots.
Retains static graph construction speed while applying cheap dynamic screening (depth 8-12) at query/retrieval time to eliminate severe evaluation divergence.
Requires engine evaluation for every historical position before graph construction; couples structural clusters to engine version and search depth volatility.
Decouples static pawn/piece structure from dynamic game state/criticality into orthogonal facets. Users can query by pawn structure and filter by dynamic state without topological interference.

recommendedArchitecture: Model D (Orthogonal Dual-Space) with Model B as Phase 2 bridge
architecturalRoadmap: Phase 1 (Complete): Production static structural clustering (Issue #702) establishes robust pawn/piece topology.
Phase 2: Introduce on-demand dynamic filtering (Model B) using screening-depth Stockfish evaluation to flag false familiarity.
Phase 3: Formalize orthogonal dual-space indexing (Model D), storing static cluster IDs and dynamic criticality/evaluation facets independently.
